pdf2ppt.name: PDF to PowerPoint
pdf2ppt.short: Turn every PDF page into a PowerPoint slide (PPTX).
pdf2ppt.title: PDF to PowerPoint – Convert PDF to PPT Slides Free | {brand}
pdf2ppt.desc: Convert PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX) online for free: every page becomes a crisp slide that keeps the exact layout. No sign-up, files never leave your device.
steps: Pick the image quality and, if you like, which pages to include.
Click Start and download your .pptx presentation.

faq.q: Will the slides look exactly like my PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Each page is placed on its own slide as a high-resolution image, so fonts, colours and layout stay identical. The slide size follows your PDF's page shape.

faq.q: Can I edit the text in PowerPoint?
faq.a: The page content is an image, so text is not directly editable. You can add new text boxes, notes and animations on top, reorder or delete slides. For editable text, use PDF to Word first.

faq.q: Does it open in Google Slides and Keynote?
faq.a: Yes. The file is a standard PPTX that opens in PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote and LibreOffice Impress.
